name: io.github.gregcastro23/alchm-kitchen
description: Eight kitchen tools: transits, ingredients, recipes, synastry, evidence snapshots and reflections.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_USER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional alchm.kitchen API key. Requires operator DATABASE_URL for validation and billing. Anonymous read tools run in demo mode; reflection publication requires authentication.

environmentVariables.name: ALCHM_MCP_USER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alias for MCP_USER_API_KEY, supported in sanitized Planetary Agents client environments.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Operator PostgreSQL connection string for API-key validation, ESMS billing, optional cache and telemetry. Without it, only anonymous demo reads are available.

environmentVariables.name: ALCHM_MCP_BACKEND_URL
environmentVariables.description: Backend origin serving /api/astrologize. Bundled artifacts default to https://alchm.kitchen; source runs default to http://localhost:3000.
